name: PowerShell Command Escaping with Mixed Quotes
symptom: Commands containing nested double quotes or backticks fail with Unexpected token or syntax error when invoked via automation runner.
rootCause: PowerShell parses backticks as escape sequences and evaluates string interpolation within double quotes, conflicting with nested CLI argument passing.
mitigation: Use PowerShell literal here-strings (@' ... '@) or pass arguments via standalone script files instead of complex inline string expressions.
